---
name: clinical-data-pipeline-mini
description: Use host-authorized data dictionaries, aggregate cohorts, and registered analyses with privacy-preserving, verifiable research controls.
---

# Clinical data pipeline

1. Inspect the host-declared data concept or schema before requesting an
   aggregate or analysis.
2. Bind each aggregate or analysis request to its approved dataset and plan
   artifact identifiers.
3. Verify counts, units, ranges, missingness, and privacy constraints in a
   bounded result before using it downstream.
4. Never request raw protected records, expand cohort access, or treat an
   aggregate as proof of individual-level facts.
